newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles, Calif., sells $270 mln school notes.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles, Calif., sells $270 mln school notes.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said Thursday it priced $270 million tax and revenue anticipation notes for the Los Angeles Unified School District, Calif.
Merrill said it priced $100 million July 1, 1998 notes with a 4.50 percent coupon to yield 3.75 percent. It priced $170 million Oct. 1, 1998 notes with a 4.50 percent coupon to yield 3.95 percent.
The notes are rated MIG-1 by Moody's Investors Service and SP1-plus by Standard & Poor's Corp.
